steps.text: Add a status badge to the demo widget in this project. Once you know where it is documented, stop and wait: write nothing until I tell you, and ask me product questions only when I tell you to.
A) Existing, specs/demo/001-demo-widget. Keep waiting: write nothing until I tell you.

Before you write anything, ask me with your question tool which colour the badge uses, offering exactly Amber, Teal and Slate. One choice. Open the tool itself, not a chat message, and mark no option as recommended.
